tools.name: find_trips
tools.description:
The quickest way to search: describe the trip in plain words and get bookable trips back in one call.

travelType, one of:
- ski: ski and snowboard holidays
- golf: golf holidays
- surf: surf camps and holidays
- diving: diving holidays
- hiking: hiking and walking holidays
- charter: package holida

tools.name: search_init
tools.description:
Use when exploring a travel type before filtering, or when find_trips lacks a needed filter: returns the destinations, months and price ranges for ONE travel type and party.

Required parameters (all four):
- niche: ONE travel type — "ski", "golf", "surf", "diving", "hiking", "charter", "cycling", "

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description:
Search for travel listings with filters, sorting, and pagination.

Use when find_trips lacks a filter the user needs.

Required parameters:
- niche: ONE travel type — "ski", "golf", "surf", "diving", "hiking", "charter", "cycling", "football", "carrental", "f1", "running", "americanfootball", "yoga"

tools.name: get_facets
tools.description:
Get facet counts for filterable fields, respecting current filters.

CRITICAL: You MUST include ALL established filters in every call — especially niche, market, adults, children, and arrivalWeeks/arrivalMonths. The facetFields parameter only controls which breakdowns are returned, NOT which filters

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" is 59537 chars, far longer than this server's median (4899). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Search for travel listings with filters, sorting, and pagination. Use when find_trips lacks a filter the user needs. Required parameters: - niche: ONE travel ty…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_listings" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Search for travel listings with filters, sorting, and pagination. Use when find_trips lacks a filter the user needs. Required parameters: - niche: ONE travel ty…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_trips, search_listings · Private data: search_listings · Public sink: search_listings · Destructive: search_listings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_trips, search_listings · Private data: search_listings · Public sink: search_listings · Destructive: search_listings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_init" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
